scope.single: One B2B0-admissible forced-color state P[u<-c], u in U=X union Y, c in A(u).
scope.pair: One B2B0-admissible equal-color nonedge state P[u<-c,v<-c], uv nonedge, c in A(u) intersect A(v).

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_SOURCE_LIST_REPARTITION_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For a B2B0 forced base state, source-list canonicalization can be performed deterministically. Let Zi be the nonfixed vertices with source-list size i under the enlarged seed. Z0 gives immediate UNSAT. Every Z1 has a unique source color; if assigning those colors is not proper against the already fixed set or within Z1, the state is immediate UNSAT. Otherwise move Z1 to X0 and set X=Z2, Y=Z3, Y0=Z4. This restores source axiom (v) while preserving (ii)-(iv); only axiom (i) may fail because X0 grew.
proof_points: Source lists depend on the seed, not on X0, so moving Z1 to X0 creates no new source-list singleton cascade.
Z4 is exactly the B2B0 canonical residual Y0, so Y0 is unchanged by Z1 promotion.
Growing X0 only removes vertices from the domain quantified by axiom (iv), hence cannot create a new mixed outside vertex on a residual edge.

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_VI_PRESERVATION_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: If the input final state satisfies source axiom (vi) with controlling seed color c0, then the canonical forced repartition also satisfies (vi) with the same controlling color c0.
proof: An old X vertex has two distinct old seed colors and seed enlargement cannot reduce that number, so old X cannot become a new 3-list Y.

An old Y0 vertex has zero old seed colors. One forced vertex or an equal-color pair contributes at most one distinct new seed color, so a hit old-Y0 vertex may become 3-list Y but belongs to a whole removed old Y0 component by B2B0 and therefore has no neighbor in retained Y0.
Hence every new Y vertex with a retained-Y0 neighbor is an old Y vertex.

Such an old Y had exactly one old seed color. If it remains a 3-list vertex after forcing, the new seed-color set still has cardinality one and contains the old one, so it is identical to the old singleton set.
Old axiom (vi) therefore supplies the same controlling color c0.

theorem_bundle.name: P7_FORCED_CONNECTIVITY_REPAIR_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: After deterministic Z1 promotion, any failure of axiom (i) is repairable exactly and constructively using only the sealed P7-free List-3 backend: each connected component C of G minus X0_plus not containing the seed is either independently UNSAT or can be colored, deleted, and stored for reconstruction. Repeating this yields an equivalent state satisfying (i)-(vi).
proof: By axiom (iii), every non-X0 vertex outside residual Y0 has a seed neighbor, so every component of G minus X0_plus disjoint from the seed is contained in residual Y0.
Before Z1 promotion, B2B0 preserved G minus old X0 connected. Hence every newly separated C has a neighbor x in Z1.
Under single/equal-color forcing, Z1 can originate only in old X: old Y can lose at most one source-list color from size 3 and old Y0 can gain at most one distinct forced seed color from size 4.
Thus x was an old dynamic vertex. Since C lies in retained old Y0, old axiom (iv) plus connectedness makes x complete or anticomplete to C; because x has a neighbor in C, x is complete to C.
Let d be the fixed color of x. Every vertex of C must avoid d. Exact constraints from all fixed X0_plus neighbors produce lists contained in the common three-color palette [4] minus {d}.
G[C] is induced P7-free, so constructive P7-free List-3 decides the component and provides a witness coloring.
If UNSAT, the whole forced state is UNSAT. If SAT, C has no nonfixed neighbor outside itself because it is a component of G minus X0_plus; store the witness and delete C.
At most O(n) such components exist. Deleting only residual components preserves (ii)-(vi) and reconstruction is the stored component colorings.

theorem_bundle.name: B0_SURVIVOR_INHERITANCE_UNDER_FORCING_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: After the forced canonical pass, every 3-list Y vertex adjacent to retained Y0 is an old Y survivor with the same source 3-list. Therefore B0 source-Z capture and survivor/component localization are inherited by restriction.
proof: Old X cannot become 3-list Y.
Hit old-Y0 vertices that become 3-list Y lie in removed whole components and do not see retained Y0.
A surviving old Y that remains 3-list retains exactly the same one-color seed mask and therefore the same source 3-list.
Residual Y0 only shrinks by whole-component deletion.
Hence every new competing survivor was already an old competing survivor of the same list class, so old O1 provenance remains valid.
O2 component uniformity follows again from current axiom (iv); coarse source annotations are recomputed at seed size s+1 or s+2 without introducing a new unbounded local coordinate.

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_COMPONENT_STACK_REENTRY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For every nonterminal forced successor after connectivity repair, the sealed C2/C0/C3 component architecture re-instantiates exactly after recomputation.
proof: The repaired state satisfies (i), (iii), (iv) and has a nonempty seed.

The sealed C2 coupling argument re-applies: if a residual Y0 component had no dynamic complete neighbor, it would be a component of G minus X0 disjoint from the seed, contradicting axiom (i). Thus every remaining residual component has D_C nonempty.
C0 then recompiles each component message using the new fixed-X0 base lists; every queried nonempty boundary mask leaves at most three colors and is handled by the sealed P7 List-3 backend.
C2 rebuilds the full dynamic/component quotient with the recomputed complete/anticomplete incidence.
C3 rebuilds at most six selectors per component and stores new state-aware reconstruction pointers.
Any B2A component-transition signatures whose inputs changed can likewise be recomputed polynomially from the newly compiled state.

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_STEP_STRICT_UNFIXED_MEASURE_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For the authorized one-step successor relation, M(P)=|V(G) minus (S union X0)| is a strict non-regenerating measure. A single force decreases M by at least 1; an equal-color pair force decreases it by at least 2. Source-singleton promotion and connectivity-component deletion can only decrease it further.
theorem_bundle.one_step_successor_bound: From a state on n vertices there are at most 4n R1 force choices and at most 4*binom(n,2) R2 equal-color nonedge choices, hence at most 2n^2+2n=O(n^2) immediate forced successors before source pruning.
theorem_bundle.nonregeneration: The authorized canonical pass never moves a vertex out of S or X0 and never restores a deleted component.
theorem_bundle.global_firewall: Strict depth <= n and polynomial immediate fanout do NOT imply a polynomial total recursion tree. Distinct forced subsets/color assignments may still generate exponentially many states. No global state-count/compression theorem is claimed.

FORCED_STEP_DELTA.retained_Y0_components: old residual components anticomplete to every forced vertex and not deleted by connectivity repair
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.vertices_whose_source_L_changed: exactly vertices seeing a forced seed color not already represented among their old seed-neighbor colors
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.vertices_whose_exact_A_shrank: source-list changes plus any additional exclusions created by newly promoted Z1 fixed vertices
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.VI_before_after: same controlling color on every residual-adjacent Y
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.B0_coarse_class_changes: survivor set only shrinks; source types/signatures are recomputed for the enlarged seed
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.component_base_system_changes: recompute for components touched by new X0 fixed-color neighborhoods
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.selector_message_recompilations_needed: yes where X0 base lists or D_C changed
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.C2_assumption_changes: restored after connectivity repair; every remaining component coupled
FORCED_STEP_DELTA.C3_assumption_changes: selectors rebuilt from recomputed C0/C2 state
